name: RethinkFun
descriptionZh: 中文深度学习入门教程，适合从数学、线性回归开始补基础。
descriptionEn: A Chinese introduction to deep learning, starting from mathematics and linear regression.

name: The Missing Semester
descriptionZh: MIT 的实用工具课程，覆盖命令行、开发环境、调试、Git、代码发布、Agentic Coding 和代码质量。
descriptionEn: MIT's practical tools course covering the shell, development environments, debugging, Git, shipping code, agentic coding, and code quality.

name: 3Blue1Brown
descriptionZh: 用动画讲线性代数、微积分、概率和神经网络，适合先建立直觉。
descriptionEn: Visual explanations of linear algebra, calculus, probability, and neural networks.

name: The Thinking Game
descriptionZh: 关于 Google DeepMind 的纪录片，适合作为课后拓展观看。
descriptionEn: A documentary about Google DeepMind, recommended as optional post-class viewing.

name: 菜鸟教程 RUNOOB
descriptionZh: 查 Python、NumPy、Pandas、Git 等基础用法很方便，适合零基础随用随查。
descriptionEn: A Chinese programming reference for Python, NumPy, Pandas, Git, and other basics.

name: GitStudy
descriptionZh: 用源码阅读、练习和浏览器实验学习开源项目，适合开始动手。
descriptionEn: Hands-on open-source learning through source reading, exercises, and browser labs.

name: Dive into Deep Learning (D2L)
descriptionZh: 《动手学深度学习》中文项目，概念、公式、代码和练习比较完整。
descriptionEn: The Chinese Dive into Deep Learning project with concepts, math, code, and exercises.

name: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
descriptionZh: Karpathy 的神经网络课程，从反向传播开始边讲边实现。
descriptionEn: Karpathy's neural-network course, building implementations from backpropagation onward.

name: Hello-Agents
descriptionZh: Datawhale 的智能体教程，包含基础概念、工具调用和实践案例。
descriptionEn: A Datawhale tutorial on agent fundamentals, tool use, and hands-on examples.

name: Happy-LLM
descriptionZh: Datawhale 的大模型入门项目，覆盖 Transformer、预训练和微调。
descriptionEn: A Datawhale introduction to Transformers, pretraining, and finetuning.

name: Hugging Face Agents Course
descriptionZh: Hugging Face 的 Agent 课程，包含基础、框架、RAG 和实践任务。
descriptionEn: Hugging Face's agents course covering fundamentals, frameworks, RAG, and projects.

name: AI4Science101
descriptionZh: DeepModeling 社区的 AI for Science 入门资料和知识库。
descriptionEn: An introductory AI-for-Science resource and knowledge base from the DeepModeling community.

name: Awesome AI for Science
descriptionZh: 按学科整理 AI for Science 工具、数据集、框架和项目，适合继续找资料。
descriptionEn: A community-curated index of AI-for-Science tools, datasets, frameworks, and projects.

name: AlphaFold
descriptionZh: Google DeepMind 的蛋白质结构预测开源项目，可作为 AI for Science 代表案例阅读。
descriptionEn: Google DeepMind's open protein-structure prediction project and a representative AI-for-Science case.

name: AI for Chemistry · EPFL CH-457
descriptionZh: EPFL 的 AI for Chemistry 课程，覆盖分子机器学习、反应预测和优化等内容。
descriptionEn: EPFL's AI-for-Chemistry course covering molecular ML, reaction prediction, optimization, and related topics.

name: DeepChem
descriptionZh: 科学机器学习工具库和教程，包含分子、材料、生物等方向。
descriptionEn: A scientific machine-learning library with tutorials for molecules, materials, biology, and more.

name: RDKit
descriptionZh: 常用化学信息学工具箱：分子表示、描述符、指纹、相似性和反应处理。
descriptionEn: A standard cheminformatics toolkit for molecular representations, descriptors, fingerprints, similarity, and reactions.

name: Chemprop
descriptionZh: 基于消息传递神经网络的分子性质预测框架。
descriptionEn: A molecular property-prediction framework based on message-passing neural networks.

name: SchNetPack
descriptionZh: 面向原子体系的机器学习工具箱，适合继续看 3D 表示和原子级模型。
descriptionEn: An atomistic machine-learning toolbox for 3D representations and atom-level models.

name: FAIRChem
descriptionZh: 计算化学、材料和催化方向的模型、数据与工具集合。
descriptionEn: Models, datasets, and tools for computational chemistry, materials science, and catalysis.

name: Materials Informatics · Best Practices
descriptionZh: 材料信息学中的数据划分、评估和常见陷阱 Notebook。
descriptionEn: Notebooks on data splitting, evaluation, and common pitfalls in materials informatics.
levelZh: 科研方法 / 最佳实践

name: Open Reaction Database
descriptionZh: 开放反应数据项目，可用来了解反应数据怎样结构化保存。
descriptionEn: An open reaction-data project for structured reaction records and synthesis data.

name: pymatgen
descriptionZh: Materials Project 生态中常用的材料结构与数据处理工具库。
descriptionEn: A widely used materials-structure and data-processing library in the Materials Project ecosystem.
